sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 234513 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $20 per campsite per night (standard and tent-only alike) in the 2025-2028 rate tables; the fee covers 2 vehicles. The $30 STANDARD ELECTRIC rate belongs to the two full-hookup sites A and B, which are management sites and not bookable ('Sites A and B = Full Hook up = $12 + $10 = $22 per night').

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/big-scrub-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', '$20 per campsite per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234513/rates (2026: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC $20, STANDARD ELECTRIC $30) + campsite catalog (Site A and Site B type MANAGEMENT, not reservable), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234513 (all 46 reservable sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC or TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC; the only hookups are at management sites A and B), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 36 standard sites (001-036; 25 of them pull-throughs; 001-012 and 017-030 take 40 ft, 013-016 are 22 ft, 031-036 20 ft) and 10 tent-only (037-046); the USFS page says 47 sites.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234513 (Max Vehicle Length and Driveway Entry per site) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/big-scrub-campground ('the 47-site Big Scrub Campground'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/big-scrub-campground ('we have showers, restrooms and drinkable water'; amenities 'Drinking water', 'Showers', 'Toilets'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 days in any 30 in all Ocala NF campgrounds. Rented RVs may not be delivered or pre-placed; the reservation holder must drive it in.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234513 ('14 day stay limit in a 30 day period in ALL Ocala National Forest Campgrounds'; facility_rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notice on RV rentals) + recreation.gov availability (sites bookable Oct 2026 - Feb 2027), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS Ocala NF campground in the Big Scrub uplands. A trailhead in the campground gives riders campsite-to-trail access to the 47-mile Ocala Centennial (Adventure) Trail. Gates open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20/night, no hookups, showers, drinking water, rec.gov booking, 14-night limit. Changed fees high $30 -> $20 (the $30 electric rate is for management sites A/B). Added 46 public sites (36 standard incl. 25 pull-throughs to 40 ft, 10 tent-only). Not settled: season (USFS says both 'Site Open' and 'This site is seasonally closed'; rec.gov sells Oct-Feb). Note cleaned.
flags: OFF-ROAD RULE: this looks like an OHV staging camp. USFS: 'Popular with OHV enthusiasts, the 47-site Big Scrub Campground ... A trailhead provides riders campsite-to-trail access for the Ocala Centennial Trail'; 'Campers with ATVs are also welcome, where there is direct access from the campground to the 47-mile Ocala Centennial Trail'. rec.gov: 'Perennially popular with off-road vehicle enthusiasts ... A trailhead within the facility offers riders campsite-to-trail access', 'All off-road vehicle riders will enjoy exploring the Tread Lightly Four Wheel Drive Way', and its notices are mostly ORV regulations. Under the curation rule (a trailhead camp inside an OHV system) it may need to drop; a human decides.
Phone: entry has 877-444-6777 (recreation.gov's reservation line); the campground's own number is (352) 625-2520 (rec.gov facility_phone / 'Please call (352) 625-2520 for general information').
